name: Qualtrics
summary: Qualtrics is an experience-management platform (surveys, CX, EX/Engagement). Its agent surface is a first-party, experimental MCP: Qualtrics "provides an MCP server for each of the APIs documented in this API reference" (one tool per JSON endpoint), over a per-brand OAuth endpoint. That reference is 321 endpoints across 46 OpenAPI specs of survey/response/contact CRUD. Its open-text theme engines (Text iQ, Text Analytics) are UI features exposed by none of those endpoints, so no MCP tool turns engagement comments into themes/quotes/counts; hr.summarize-engagement-feedback is empty.

payments.notes: qualtrics.com/pricing (200, read 2026-11-16) shows no currency figure and routes to Request demo; quote-based/enterprise. The listed MCP surface requires the purchased API feature and a Brand-Administrator OAuth client, so it is not reachable on a free survey account. Not machine-payable.

agentAccess.notes: Not keyless and not probed: the MCP endpoint is per-brand (e.g. my-brand.iad1.qualtrics.com/API/mcp/<server>), not a fixed public URL, so no anonymous endpoint exists to probe. Access is OAuth 2.0 (authorization_code, or client_credentials Bearer) via an OAuth client a Brand Administrator registers.
